title: OrcaFault
description: Vanilla based pack with a little bit of tweaks for SMP. Credits to its rightful owner
body:
This texture pack is a remake of Orca Tsunamis 1.16 PVP Texture pack in Youtube. I remade this pack since the original was outdated and can only be used for 1.16 version. This has been sitting on my pack folders for a month now and I decided to upload it on Modirnth. Credits to its rightful owner (Orca Tsunami)

# About this
Vanilla texture pack that is tweaked to your liking for SMP 

**Changes**
- Lower Shield
- Particles
- Lower Fire
- GUI
- Tools
- Golden Apple
- Ender Pearl
